action.message: module.py replaces the summing stub with a validated ledger implementing solve(data) per the contract. Checks run in order: kind, amount (int >= 1, bools rejected), hold id uniqueness or release id existence, then available-funds check for debit and hold. Credit, debit, hold, and release update balance and held as specified, and the input is not mutated. run_tests passed the 3 public cases (empty ops, credit/debit, credit/hold), with input_mutated false. Only the public tests were run, so hidden edge cases are unverified. Unhashable id values (e.g. lists) would raise TypeError rather than ValueError; the contract doesn't cover this. test_cases.json was not part of the allowed files, so no receipt bound to it was produced.
